topics.h1: Express Entry Canada: Your Complete 2026 Guide
topics.lead: Express Entry is the federal system Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC) uses to manage applications for three economic immigration programs — the Federal Skilled Worker Program, the Canadian Experience Class, and the Federal Skilled Trades Program. Candidates are ranked by a Comprehensive Ranking System (CRS) score, and IRCC periodically invites the highest-ranked candidates in each draw to apply for permanent residence. Since 2023, an increasing share of invitations has come…

topics.label: Federal Skilled Worker
topics.seoTitle: Federal Skilled Worker Program (FSW) Canada 2026 | CMG
topics.metaDescription: Federal Skilled Worker Program requirements for 2026: the 67-point grid, CLB 7 language rules, ECA requirements, and CRS strategy. Free RCIC assessment.
topics.lead: The Federal Skilled Worker Program is one of three programs managed through Express Entry, designed specifically for candidates applying with foreign work experience — most often from outside Canada. Unlike the Canadian Experience Class, FSW candidates must first clear a 67-point minimum on the program's own selection grid before their CRS score is even considered for a draw.

topics.label: Canadian Experience Class
topics.seoTitle: Canadian Experience Class (CEC) 2026: Requirements & CRS | CMG
topics.metaDescription: CEC eligibility for 2026: 1 year Canadian work experience, CLB requirements, and current draw cutoffs. PGWP-to-PR strategy from a licensed RCIC — free review.
topics.lead: The Canadian Experience Class is built for candidates who already have skilled work experience inside Canada — most commonly, international graduates who transitioned from a study permit to a Post-Graduation Work Permit. CEC has been the most consistently active Express Entry program through 2025–2026, with no minimum education requirement of its own.

topics.label: Federal Skilled Trades
topics.seoTitle: Federal Skilled Trades (FST) Program Canada 2026 | CMG
topics.metaDescription: FST eligibility for tradespeople: 2 years' experience, CLB 4/5 language requirements, job offer or certificate of qualification. Free RCIC eligibility review.
topics.lead: The Federal Skilled Trades Program is the Express Entry pathway built specifically for qualified tradespeople, and is frequently paired with the trades category-based draw lane, which has run at CRS scores well below the general pool.

topics.label: PNP-Linked Express Entry
topics.metaDescription: How a provincial nomination adds 600 CRS points to your Express Entry profile — the aligned-stream process explained. Free eligibility check.
topics.lead: A PNP-linked application is a provincial nomination obtained through a stream specifically aligned with Express Entry — the nomination adds 600 CRS points directly to an existing profile, rather than running as a separate application outside the federal system entirely.
headings: How PNP-Linked Differs From a Base PNP Stream

topics.label: Provincial Nominee Program (all provinces, consolidated)
topics.seoTitle: Provincial Nominee Program (PNP) Canada 2026: All Provinces | CMG
topics.metaDescription: Compare PNP streams across all 10 Canadian provinces and territories. A nomination adds 600 CRS points — see which stream fits your profile. Free assessment.
topics.lead: Every Canadian province and territory except Quebec and Nunavut operates at least one Provincial Nominee Program stream. A nomination adds a flat 600 points to a candidate's Express Entry CRS score — enough to place nearly any nominated candidate above recent draw cutoffs — while some provincial streams run entirely outside Express Entry with their own separate process.

topics.label: British Columbia PNP
topics.seoTitle: British Columbia PNP 2026: Streams & Requirements | CMG
topics.metaDescription: British Columbia Provincial Nominee Program streams for 2026: eligibility focus, Express Entry alignment, and what makes this province's PNP distinct.
topics.lead: British Columbia's nominee program focuses on Skills Immigration Registration System (SIRS) — tech, healthcare, and skilled worker categories. A nomination under this program can add 600 CRS points to an Express Entry profile where the stream is aligned, or lead to permanent residence through the province's own separate process where it isn't.

topics.label: Alberta PNP (AAIP)
topics.metaDescription: Alberta Provincial Nominee Program streams for 2026: eligibility focus, Express Entry alignment, and what makes this province's PNP distinct.
topics.lead: Alberta's nominee program focuses on Alberta Opportunity Stream and an Express Entry-aligned stream. A nomination under this program can add 600 CRS points to an Express Entry profile where the stream is aligned, or lead to permanent residence through the province's own separate process where it isn't.
